name: capture-message
description: Atalhos para rodar os serviços whatsapp + endpoint (local ou Docker)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm ci --prefix apps/endpoint && npm ci --prefix apps/whatsapp
scripts.dev: concurrently -n endpoint,whatsapp -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix apps/endpoint" "npm run dev --prefix apps/whatsapp"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/endpoint && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/whatsapp
